Builder derived from openssl-src 400.0.2+4.0.3 (MIT/Apache-2.0). Upstream OpenSSL C sources come unchanged from the exact pinned openssl-src-upstream package through its public source_dir() API. Changes: source_dir()/version() forward to that package; explicit tls-deprecated-ec feature adds the public OpenSSL Configure enable-tls-deprecated-ec flag. This makes legacy certificate curves available to complete SSL; it does not add them to any default key exchange group policy, enable old TLS versions, lower global security levels, or change certificate verification.
